column1: # The lexicographic ranking on the FROZEN dimensions (R0,R1,R2,R3,R4,R5,R6).
# Lower wins; R0 is the first and strongest dimension.
# This is the VERBATIM output of the PolyC-native ranker
# over the dimension table ranking-dimensions.tsv.  The `eligible`
# column that the ranker consumes is the OUTPUT of the eligibility
# checker, so an ineligible candidate cannot enter the ranking at all.
# The R1..R6 MEANINGS are frozen and are restated verbatim in
# Schema: rank <TAB> candidate_id <TAB> R0 <TAB> R1 <TAB> R2 <TAB> R3 <TAB> R4 <TAB> R5 <TAB> R6 <TAB> current_source_location <TAB> selection_status <TAB> notes
